scripts.dev: npm run bundle -w @moco/renderer && npm run dev -w @moco/desktop
scripts.build: npm run bundle -w @moco/renderer && npm run build -w @moco/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run prepare-browser -w @moco/renderer && npm run bundle -w @moco/renderer && npm run dist -w @moco/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/spec && tsc -p packages/kit && tsc -p packages/renderer && tsc -p packages/ai && tsc -p packages/audio && tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/desktop
